meta.title: AI Governance Radar
meta.geographic_scope: 193 UN members + State of Palestine + Holy See
meta.geography_note: The map is a vector map drawn in the browser with d3-geo in the Equal Earth projection from TopoJSON country shapes, so it stays sharp at every zoom level: scroll, pinch or the + / − buttons zoom, dragging pans, and the reset button returns to the world view. The September 2026 UN Correct the Map resolution encourages Equal Earth and other equal-area projections. Country shapes are simplified Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 Countries and the land outline beneath them is Natural Earth 1:50m; neither is official UN boundary data, and the boundaries shown do not imply any position on territorial status. All 195 countries are represented. Filters by governance category, document type, issuing organisation and record status highlight the countries with at least one matching national document and dim the rest; an optional checkbox also counts regional instruments that apply to a country (such as the EU AI Act). Selecting an international body (EU, GCC, AU, ASEAN, Council of Europe, UNESCO) highlights its member countries; for the Council of Europe, CETS 225 ratifications, CETS 225 signatures, Convention 108 parties and other member states are shown in separate shades. Document lists can be sorted newest first (the default), by legal weight (binding law, treaty, regulation, mandatory policy, guidance, strategy, draft) or grouped by category. The Updates tab lists the government actions dated within the last two months across all countries, newest first, filterable by country and by type (new, revised, applied). The whole dataset or a single country can be exported as CSV or JSON. Flags are embedded SVG images from the MIT-licensed flag-icons collection, version 7.5.0.
meta.evidence_policy: Only located official sources are listed. Source location is distinguished from document-level metadata review. Null values mean unverified; missing records do not establish absence.
meta.regional_policy: EU records stored once and inherited by 27 Member States. Other regional layers browsable without assumed national adoption.
meta.source_check_policy: Automated GET checks assess accessibility only, not correctness or current legal status.
meta.change_policy: Every change is logged as a dated event. World events (published, revised, consultation, adopted, applied, superseded, repealed) record government actions; radar events (added, corrected, removed, link) record changes to this database. Automatically detected events stay marked 'needs review' until confirmed against the official source.
